$comment: Canonical matn identities for the hadith narrations the Golden Set requires. A group is one narration; its members are rows the corpus holds separately because each carries its own chain. Membership is the same report or instruction, not the same topic: wording and chain may differ, the operative content may not. The canonical label is the group's identity key; the Golden Set's required label need not be the canonical. A label outside every group is its own identity, so it can never match another. Owner-signed gate data: adding a group or a member changes what citation validity accepts.
